item.tib: brag btsan dmar po'i yig sna gsal them
item.coloph: 'di bstan pa la thug na spyad par bya/ srog la thug na bsgrub par bya/ gnad la dbab na rbad par bya/ gal la bab na 'bod par bya/ 'di yi spel gcig rgyud mi bcad do/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ dam med la bstan la rang la ldog bstan srung a bse rgyal ba 'di/ bstan pa srung ba'i rgyal mtshan yin/ rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi srog mkhar yin/ rgyal khams bskor ba'i srung ma yin/ bsad na gang yang gsod pa yin/ skyabs na 'chi bdag bdud kyang skyobs pa yin/ zlog na thams cad zlog pa'i khro bo yin/ dgra bo myur du 'chi ba'i btsan dug yin/ dgra srog gcod pa'i spu gri yin/ rkang gnyis 'brang pa'i rgya zor yin/ dam nyams bsgral ba'i mtshon cha yin/ bon dgra gsod pa'i dug mda' yin/ bod khams skyong pa'i dgra lha yin/ bstan pa bon gyi srung ma yin/ gshen chen klu dga'i mdzad srol yin/ a jo gsang ba'i yig sna yin/ dang po skyid mkhar bla ma zhu chen nas/ rim gyis brgyud nas su/ bla ma'i drung du bsod nams ye shes kyis zhus/ de la blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de nas rim gyis brgyud nas/ bdag gi bka' srung u ya smaro/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ag tham//
